# Best slim Qi2 / MagSafe power banks for iPhone 17

**Best overall slim pick: Anker Nano Power Bank (5K, MagGo, Slim)** for **$54.99**
- It is 0.34" thick and 4.3 oz, with 5,000mAh and Qi2-certified 15W wireless charging. Anker's page markets it for the iPhone 17 series.
- 9to5Mac's reviewer has used it and says it feels premium, runs cool, and is probably the closest alternative to Apple's own MagSafe battery.
- Buy: [Anker US](https://www.anker.com/products/a1665-5k-ultra-slim-qi2-power-bank)

**Thinnest and lightest: Baseus Picogo Air AM71 (5K)** for about **$53-70**
- It is 0.27" thick and 104g. Android Central calls it the thinnest and lightest of the 2026 slim banks it tested.
- Its wireless charging tops out at 7.5W, which is slower than the Anker. Pick it only if size matters more than speed.
- Buy: [Android Central review with Amazon links](https://www.androidcentral.com/accessories/power-charging/i-tested-the-best-slim-qi2-power-banks-released-in-2026-baseus-torras-iniu-reelcharge)

**Slim with more capacity: INIU SnapGo Air (10K, 25W Qi2.2)** for about **$43-49**
- It is 0.5" thick and 195g. Macworld lists it as tied for the slimmest 10K MagSafe pack.
- iPhone 17 supports 25W wireless charging. The pack also has 45W wired output and a built-in lanyard-style USB-C cable, though it has no kickstand.
- It is the best value here for a 10K slim pack. Buy: [Android Central review with Amazon links](https://www.androidcentral.com/accessories/power-charging/i-tested-the-best-slim-qi2-power-banks-released-in-2026-baseus-torras-iniu-reelcharge)

**Other options**
- **Baseus PicoGo AM52 (10K, 25W Qi2.2, 45W wired):** $53.99 with code AM52, per Dealectric, which tested the code in Baseus's cart on Oct 24. It lists no thickness, so I can't say how slim it is. This is an affiliate link: [Buy at Baseus](https://dealectric.com/go/baseus-picogo-am52-qi2-2-10000mah-45w)
- **TORRAS MiniMag Pro (10K, 15W):** IP54 dust and water resistance, 0.57" thick, about $70-80. [Android Central](https://www.androidcentral.com/accessories/power-charging/i-tested-the-best-slim-qi2-power-banks-released-in-2026-baseus-torras-iniu-reelcharge)

**How to choose**
- A 5K pack usually recharges a phone about 60-75%. A 10K pack gives close to two charges, per [Macworld](https://www.macworld.com/article/668978/feature-best-magsafe-magnetic-portable-battery-packs-power-banks-for-iphone.html).
- Only 25W Qi2.2 packs (INIU, Baseus AM52) will charge your iPhone 17 faster than 15W. Slim 5K packs are capped at 15W or lower.
- Prices change often, so check the final price at checkout.

If you carry your phone in your pocket every day, I'd get the Anker Nano. If you want more battery without much bulk, I'd get the INIU SnapGo Air.
